title: Yummy Algerian Bouillon Wrap
description: A cozy, glassy-jelly wrap filled with fresh veggies and a savory chicken bouillon yogurt sauce, perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Whisk yogurt, chicken bouillon powder, olive oil, lemon juice, honey, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Rinse and pat dry the ssam-wrap leaves.
Spread a thin layer of the yogurt sauce onto each leaf.
Divide the shredded carrots and sliced cucumber evenly among the leaves.
Fold the sides of each leaf over the filling and roll tightly.
Place the wrapped bundles on a plate and drizzle with a little extra sauce if desired.
Serve immediately for a fresh and comforting wrap.
If you prefer a slightly warm version, steam the wrapped bundles for 2 minutes before serving.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
Enjoy the glassy, flavorful experience of this Algerian-inspired lunch.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
